name: TJ's Grill (Montpelier, ID) Grilled Chicken Breast Dinner & Idaho Baked Potato
searchKeywords: grilled chicken baked potato bear lake
whyItWorks: Clean, wholesome Idaho roadside dinner! Boneless skinless chicken breast grilled with light seasoning, served with a fluffy Idaho baked potato. Pure protein and potassium-rich soft starch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Grilled Chicken Breast with a baked Idaho potato (eat the soft inside flesh with butter, skip tough potato skin).
watchOuts: Discard tough baked potato skin during flare periods
